hypotheses.title: Diverse Mathematical Architectures: 52-Week High Proximity, Volume-Return Correlation & IV Term Contango
hypotheses.economic_rationale: To break free from repetitive quadratic rank templates and secure Alpha 12, Batch 35 introduces three structurally diverse mathematical formulations spanning market microstructure, behavioral finance, and derivatives term structures: (1) George & Hwang 52-Week High Proximity Momentum: exploits psychological anchoring where investors underreact to informational breakthroughs near historical peaks (close / ts_max(high, 252)); (2) Institutional Volume-Return Synchronization: computes the rolling 20-day bivariate correlation between daily returns and volume (-ts_correlation(returns, volume, 20)), isolating institutional accumulation from retail distribution; (3) Implied Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope: captures option volatility term structure steepness (implied_volatility_mean_90 / implied_volatility_mean_30) without unit mismatch, rewarding equities with calm institutional vol regimes. None of these candidates employ signed_power or delta-close overlays, ensuring unique alpha footprints and low cross-alpha correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 52-week high breakouts rapidly mean-revert or if implied volatility term inversion fails to forecast short-term underperformance.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (PV1): George & Hwang 52-Week High Anchoring Proximity Ratio. Pure market data momentum with zero fundamental or analyst correlation. Target Sharpe >= 1.60, Fitness >= 1.35 in TOP1000.
Candidate 2 (PV1): 20-Day Price-Volume Correlation Reversal. Microstructure signal detecting institutional accumulation vs retail panic selling. Target Sharpe >= 1.50, Fitness >= 1.25 in TOP1000.

Candidate 3 (Option8): 90d-to-30d Implied Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope. Pure unitless options ratio detecting tail-risk calm vs backwardation panic. Target Sharpe >= 1.65, Fitness >= 1.40 in TOP1000.
